I thought melatonin was a vitamin. Or maybe a mineral. Something you take to fill a nutritional gap. I was completely wrong. And understanding what melatonin actually is changed everything about how I explain it to customers — and why it works better for sleep than almost anything else we stock. --- So What Exactly Is Melatonin? Melatonin is not a vitamin. Melatonin is not a mineral. Melatonin is not a herbal supplement. Melatonin is a hormone. Specifically it is a hormone that your own body already produces naturally — made by a tiny gland in your brain called the pineal gland.
